The word स्व 'own', when it does not mean a kinsman or property is optionally सर्वनाम before the affix जस्।

Terms: सर्वनाम
The words स्वर् 'heaven' etc. and the particles -- निपात एकाजनाङ्

, are called अव्यय or indeclinables.

Terms: अव्यय

In this Grammar, when an operation is directed with regard to a word, the individual form of the word posesssing meaning is to be understood, except with regard to aword which is a definition.

Terms:

The Monotony takes the place of the अनुदात्त vowels which follow the स्वरित vowels, in close proximity (संहिता).

Terms:

The word श्वशुर 'father-in-law', is optionally only retained, when spoken of along with श्वशुरू 'mother-in-law'.

Terms: श्वशुर

In these aphorisms, when a word is marked with a स्वरित accent, by that an अधिकार or a governing rule is to be understood.

Terms: स्वरित

After the verb marked with a स्वरित or which has an indicatory ञित् , the terminations of the आत्मनेपद are used, when the fruit of the action accrues to the agent.

Terms: आत्मनेपद
When the affixes beginning with a सु
and ending in कप्
follow, not being सर्वनामस्थान

then that which precedes is called पद।

Terms: पद संज्ञा

Whatever the speaker chooses as the independent, principal and absolute source of action is called कर्ता or agent.

Terms: कारक-कर्म

The indeclinable word स्वयम् 'oneself' is compounded with a word ending in the affix क्त and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।

Terms: समास-तत्-पुरुष

The 6th and the 7th case-affixes are used after words when they are joined with स्वामिन् 'master', ईश्वर 'lord', अधिपति 'ruler', दायाद 'an heir', साक्षिन् 'witness', प्रतिभू 'a surety' and प्रसूत 'begotten'.

Terms: विभक्ति-6, 7

The affix श्नु comes after the roots of स्वादि class when a सार्वधातुक affix denoting an agent follows.

Terms: श्नु

The affix नजिङ् comes, in the sense of 'agent having such a habit etc.' after the verbs स्वप् 'to sleep' and तृष् 'to be thirsty'.

Terms: नजिङ्

The affix अप् comes optionally after the verbs 1. स्वन् 2. हस् when no उपसर्ग is in composition with them.

Terms: अप्

The affix नन् comes under similar circumstances after the verb स्वप् 'to sleep'.

Terms: नन्

(When the actions signified by the verbs कृ 'to make' and another have the same agent), the affix णमुल् is added to the verb कृ 'to make' which is concerned about a time anterior to that of the other), provided that a word signifying 'sweet' is in composition.

Terms: णमुल्

The affix णमुल् comes after a verb when a word in the Accusative -2nd case is in composition, signifying the limbs of one's own body, when the limb is such that its loss will not destroy life.

Terms: णमुल्

The affixes क्तवा and णमुल् are added to the roots कृ 'to make' and भू 'to be', in composition with a word denoting a member of one's own body when the affix तस् is joined thereto.

Terms: क्तवा and णमुल्

And the feminine affix ङीष् comes optionally after what ends with the name of a part of the body when the word is a subordinate member in compound and has not a conjunct for its penultimate letter (i.e. the final अ is not preceded by a double consonant).

Terms: विभक्ति-ङीष्

The affix छ comes in the sense of descendant after the word स्वसृ।

Terms: छ

The affix ठञ् comes optionally comes in the remaining senses after the word श्वस् and it takes the augment तुट्।

Terms: ठञ्

The affixes ठञ् and ष्ठन् , come after the word श्वगण , in the sense of 'he goes by means thereof'.

Terms: ठञ् and ष्ठन्

The affix कन् comes in the sense of 'who takes care of it, who bestows care upon' after a word denoting a part of one's body.

Terms: कन्

The irregularly formed word स्वामिन् denotes 'Sir or Lord'.

Terms: Irregular

The affix अच् comes after the words 1. वसीयस् and 2. श्रेयस् when they follow the word श्वस् in a compound.

Terms: अच्

Of the causative verb स्वपि 'to casuse one to sleep', there is vocalisation of the semi-vowel, when the affix चङ् of the Reduplicated Aorist follows.

Terms: लिट् लकार

There is vocalisation of the semi-vowel, of the verbs स्वप् 'to sleep', स्यम् 'to shout' and व्ये 'to cover', when followed by the affix यङ् of the Intensive.

Terms: लिट् लकार

The acute accent is optionally on the first syllable when a Personal-ending, being सार्वधातुक tense affix beginning with a vowel, provided that the vowel is not the augment इट् , follows after स्वप् etc., or after हिंस्।

Terms: accent-तिङ्

The first member of a तत्-पुरुष समास preserves its original accent when it denotes a thing possessed and when its second term is स्वामिन्।

Terms: तत्-पुरुष समास

A feminine in ई ending in the name of a part of body does not become masculine except the word मानिन् follows.

Terms: Masculisation

The व of 1. श्वन् 2. युवन् and 3. मधवन् becomes vocalised, but not before a तद्धित affix.

Terms: व vocalisation

The Nominative 1st-Case and Accusative -2nd case endings सु and अम् are elided after a neutral अङ्ग (stem).

Terms: Some substitution

A वलादि आर्धधातुक affix optionally takes इट् after स्वृ , after the two roots सू (सूति and सूयति) after धूञ् and after a root which has an indicatory long ऊ।

Terms: इट् augment
The prohibition and the augment ordained by न य्वाभ्यां पदान्ताभ्याम् पूर्वौ तु ताभ्यामैच्

, do not apply also to स्वागत etc.

Terms: वृद्धि
A compound beginning with श्वन् and followed by the तद्धित affix इञ् is not governed by the prohibition nor takes the augment taught in द्वारादीनां च

.

Terms: वृद्धि

The अ is substituted for the final of श्वि in the Aorist अङ्।

Terms: Shortening

The single substitute of an unaccented vowel standing at the beginning of a word, with an उदात्त (acute accent) vowel may optionally be a स्वरित or उदात्त (acute accent).

Terms: Accent

Of the two Vocatives of the same form standing at the beginning of a sentence, the end vowel of the first becomes प्लुत and स्वरित when envy, praise, anger or blame is expressed.

Terms: प्लुत

रु is substituted for the न् of स्वतवान् before पायु।

Terms: Nasal रु
